# Dark Executive

Category: `professional` · Audience: Technical leaders, enterprise consultants, and fractional CTOs · Output: static HTML/CSS/JS

Enterprise power meets midnight UI — amber-gold accents on near-black for technical leaders who ship at scale.

A persistent identity/navigation rail, decisive value proposition, semantic architecture table, career timeline, advisory capabilities, and a consultation CTA.

## Design tokens

| Token | Exact value |
| --- | --- |
| accent | `#f59e0b` |
| background | `#060608` |
| text | `#f5f5f0` |
| muted | `#9ca3af` |
| surface | `#0e0e14` |
| border | `#1c1c24` |
| Body family | 'Source Sans 3', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif |
| Heading family | 'Source Sans 3', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif |
| Font styles | body: sans; heading: sans |
| Density | comfortable |

Text, muted text, and accent contrast against the background / card surface:

| Foreground | Background | Surface |
| --- | --- | --- |
| text | 18.51:1 | 17.59:1 |
| muted | 7.97:1 | 7.58:1 |
| accent | 9.43:1 | 8.96:1 |

The preset text combinations exceed 4.5:1. Decorative borders are not used to convey essential information. Custom colors need a new contrast check; this palette check alone is not a full WCAG conformance audit.
